findings.evidence: Census (script-derived from rows_v2.jsonl): p01 = 0/24 rows cite any staged-inventory filename or stem; p02 = 33/33 rows cite at least one filename-with-extension ('eccl_device_inventory.json': 32 rows, 'pmarks_Eccl.json': 10 rows, 'web_mt_offset_map.json': 1 row, 'risk_signals.jsonl': 1 row); p03 = 29/29 rows cite at least one bare stem ('eccl_device_inventory': 29 rows, 'pmarks_Eccl': 6 rows, 'book_observation': 1 row). WRITER_BRIEF.md defines observed_substrate_signals as 'list of short strings naming substrate signals you actually consulted for this row's zone, from the staged slices' -- naming the SIGNAL is the contract; naming the FILE is not required, and p01 proves the same contract is satisfiable without ever naming a file. TOOLKIT.md's REGISTER PURGE rule bars 'TOOL FILENAMES in row prose EVER' without carving out an exception for this field, and the standing rules state observed_substrate_signals 'IS A DEPENDENT FIELD of every driver swap' -- i.e. part of the same row scrutinized under REGISTER PURGE, not a quarantined audit-only channel. RECOMMENDATION: normalize at assembly -- this is a register violation to fix, not an acceptable citation convention to keep.
